blocks.text: ISTANBUL, Turkey — Thousands of people gathered in several cities across Turkey on Wednesday to protest violence against women, AFP correspondents said. Around 3,000 people joined a demonstration in Istanbul under heavy police presence after authorities banned gatherings in Taksim Square. “Under a police blockade, we are trying to hold a protest on November 25, the International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women,” 34-year-old protester Gizem Kuzuk said. “Women’s demands concerning their own lives … and their freedoms are being ignored,” she said. “Unfortunately, even on November 25, there is a state mentality that prevents women from marching against […]...
